query: Key contributions and follow-ups of 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017)
highlights: The paper introduces the concept of scaled dot-product attention which is a key component of the Transformer architecture [1, p.4, Fig.2].
Multi-head attention mechanism allows the model to focus on different positions from different representational subspaces [1, p.4, Fig.2].
The Transformer model outperforms previous state-of-the-art models in terms of BLEU score for English-to-German and English-to-French translations [1, p.8].
The Transformer architecture reduces training costs significantly while maintaining high performance [1, p.8].
